تختتمون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَتِمُونَ (taḵtatimūna) /tax.ta.ti.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# تُخْتَتَمُونَ (tuḵtatamūna) /tux.ta.ta.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
